zydeco: n. 柴迪科舞[曲](美國一種黑人舞曲)(亦作zodico, zologo)
n. music of southern Louisiana that combines French dance melodies with Caribbean music and blues
zygapophysis:
n. 脊椎關節突
[醫] 椎骨關節突

n. One of the articular processes of a vertebra, of
which there are usually four, two anterior and two posterior. See under
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自 zyg- ＋ apophysis</dd></dl>
zygodactyl:
a. 對趾的
n. 對趾鳥
a. (of bird feet) having the first and fourth toes directed backward the second and third forward
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">zygodactyl、zygodactyle 為國際科學詞彙 zyg- ＋ dactyl；zygodactylous 源自 zyg- ＋ -dactylous</dd></dl>
zygoma:
n. 頰骨, 顴骨, 顳骨突起
[醫] 顴骨; 顴弓
n. the slender arch formed by the temporal process of the cheekbone that bridges to the zygomatic process of the temporal bone
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自希臘語 zygōma，源自 zygoun 加軛、連接，源自 zygon 軛——另見 yoke</dd></dl>
zygomatic:
a. 頰骨的, 顴骨的
[醫] 顴的, 顴骨的
a. of or relating to the cheek region of the face
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語 zygomaticus，源自 zygomat-, zygoma ＋拉丁語 -icus（-ic）</dd></dl>
zygosity: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語 zygosis ＋ 英語 -ity</dd></dl>
zygospore:
n. 接合孢子
[醫] 接合孢子
n. a plant spore formed by two similar sexual cells
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 zyg- ＋ spore</dd></dl>
zygote:
n. 合子, 受精卵
[醫] 合子
n. (genetics) the diploid cell resulting from the union of a haploid spermatozoon and ovum (including the organism that develops from that cell)
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>生物學術語，偏專業</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>希臘 zygotos「結合在一起的」，原意是兩個細胞結合而成的細胞</dd></dl>
zygotene: n. [生](細胞減數分裂前期的)偶線期,合線期
n the second stage of the prophase of meiosis
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 zyg- ＋ -tene；最初構成為法語 zygotène</dd></dl>
zymase: n. a complex of enzymes that cause glycolysis; originally found in yeast but also present in higher organisms
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 zym- ＋ -ase</dd></dl>
zymogen:
n. 酶原, 發酵性細菌
[化] 酶原
n any of a group of compounds that are inactive precursors of enzymes and require some change (such as the hydrolysis of a fragment that masks an active enzyme) to become active
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 zym- ＋ -gen</dd></dl>
